tool.name: Praat
tool.command:
mkdir -p "\$PWD/praat_workspace/inputs" "\$PWD/praat_workspace/outputs" && ln -s "\$PWD/praat_workspace" /workspace &&
## Tell the container's startup script where to find the Praat workspace. export PRAAT_WORKDIR=/workspace &&
#from os.path import splitext #from re import sub #for $i, $dataset in enumerate($datasets) #set $stem = sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+', '_', splitext(str($dataset.name))[0]).strip('._') or 'sanitized_name_empty' #set $filename = "input_%s_%s_galaxy_hid_%s.%s" % ($i, $stem, $dataset.hid, $dataset.ext)
printf 'Copying Galaxy dataset into inputs directory as %s\n' '${filename}'; cp '$dataset' "\$PRAAT_WORKDIR/inputs/${filename}"; #end for
## Make only the outputs directory writable by Praat. chown --reference="\$PWD" "\$PRAAT_WORKDIR/outputs" && /init

param.name: datasets
param.label: Files to open in Praat
param.help: Select audio, TextGrids, or other Praat-readable files. Files open automatically when the desktop starts.

tool.help:
Praat provides interactive speech analysis, visualization, and annotation.
Launch this tool and open the desktop from Active Interactive Tools. Selected files are copied into the inputs directory and opened automatically. They have numbered filenames; your original Galaxy datasets are not modified.
Save results directly in the outputs directory, then close Praat by clicking on the red square under Praat in the Interactive Tools panel. The container finishes and Galaxy collects the saved files into a collection. Closing the browser tab leaves the desktop running.
Browser audio is enabled in the image. If playback is silent, enable audio in the web interface and select PulseAudio under Praat's Sound playing preferences. Browser microphone recording is not provided by this setup.
Galaxy currently only supports .wav and .TextGrid files as input files. Output is also limited to .TextGrid files. It is also not yet possible to run Praat scripts in the interactive tool.
